name: Clipboard History
description: Persist a rolling clipboard history (encrypted) and surface helpers to retrieve recent entries.
author: cognia-next

maxEntries.description: Maximum number of clipboard entries to retain.

privacyMode.description: When true, do not persist entries — only surface the most recent in-memory.

pollIntervalMs.description: Polling interval (ms). 0 disables automatic capture; entries are then only added by explicit tool / slash-command calls.
